name: ablation-three
purpose: Three-task interface ablation slice spanning Template, Financial Model, and Debugging. Run each task under arms A, B, and C with an identical model, dollar cap, and call ceiling.
contamination: All three tasks are burned development data with published or previously scored results. This is deliberate and does not invalidate the experiment: contamination is symmetric across arms, so the A/B/C comparison remains valid even though no arm's absolute score is a held-out result. Never quote these as benchmark performance.
